mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (product_id, user_id, quantity, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{userId}, #{quantity}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity), modified_at = #{modifiedAt}, modified_by = #{modifiedBy}
mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, p.product_name, p.category_name, p.price, p.shipping_price, p.images FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.product_id WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_session ( session_id, product_id, quantity, user_id, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{userId}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT ps.product_id, quantity, p.product_name, p.category_name, p.price, p.shipping_price, p.images FROM payment_session ps LEFT JOIN product p ON ps.product_id = p.product_id WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
